description: Reviews repository-root invocations of the Rozee search CLI when they send query or listing data to Rozee.pk. It covers bun run and direct bun launches with the .agents/... or ./.agents/... relative script path. Absolute paths and invocations from other working directories are not covered by this extension and remain subject to Guard's base policies.
name: Rozee job-search CLI network requests
saferAlternatives: Review the search query before sending it; do not include personal or confidential information.
Use the CLI's --help option to read usage without making a network request.
